name: Baked Falafel with Yogurt Dip
ingredients: ¾ cup (150 g) dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained (not canned)
½ small onion and 2 garlic cloves
½ cup each parsley and coriander
1 tsp each cumin and coriander powder
Dip: ½ cup plain low-fat yogurt, ¼ cucumber (grated), 1 garlic clove, lemon juice, salt
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs and spices in a food processor to a coarse, crumbly mix (not a paste).
Stir in the chickpea flour and baking powder. Chill for 20 minutes.
Shape into 8 patties and place on a lined tray. Brush with the oil.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Mix the dip ingredients and serve with the falafel.
note: Use soaked, uncooked chickpeas for a proper falafel texture; canned chickpeas turn mushy.
